text: Jason Calacanis explains his approach to investing in young technology companies, drawing on his experience as both an entrepreneur and an early investor. He describes how investors assess founders and ventures, weigh possible returns against risk, and develop relationships with the companies they support. Intended for aspiring investors as well as founders seeking backing, the book offers a view into the priorities and decisions behind startup funding.
sourceName: Harper Business, via Free Library of Philadelphia
author: Jason Calacanis
